items.title: 400+ Furniture Add-On
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
- Craft furniture in your own survival world with 400+ different furniture variations!
- Use the furniture to decorate your houses and world!

faqEntries.heading: How do I pick up furniture?
faqEntries.content: Simply press the attack button twice to pick up a furniture model.

faqEntries.heading: How do I get the Change Tool?
faqEntries.content: You can get the Change Tool by putting a Dodo Coin in a Stonecutter. The Change Tool allows you to change the appearance of any furniture model!

howToEntries.content: The 400+ Furniture Add-On adds over 400 unique furniture variations to your worlds!

howToEntries.heading: 1. Craft Furniture
howToEntries.content: All furniture models can be crafted in a Stonecutter using a Dodo Coin. To craft a Dodo Coin, surround 1 Emerald with 8 Gold Ingots in a Crafting Table.

howToEntries.heading: 2. Unlock More Variations
howToEntries.content: With over 400 furniture variations, your inventory would fill up fast! Instead, use the Change Tool to change the appearance of any furniture model. This lets you decorate entire mansions with just a few items!
